svg.title: Choosing hosting and Postgres after your first 100 paying users
svg.desc: A cost curve for Prisma Postgres from 100 to 12,000 monthly active users at 20 actions a day: the Starter plan holds at $10 to about 1,700 users, then rises and crosses the Pro plan's flat $49 at about 9,800 users, where the crossover is marked. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand.

g.text: Monthly cost by active users, at 20 actions per user per day
